normalized_text: welcome to a new video in this video i'm going to be speaking about a very famous prophecy that's mentioned in the quran which is the byzantines defeating the persians after their initial defeat within a time limit within nine years the byzantines have been defeated in nearby land they will reverse their defeat with a victory in a few years time the words used for a few years in arabic buddhism means three to nine years initially gambling was permissible in islam and when the polytheists had heard of these verses they challenged obar to a wager in which they agreed to a time limit of five years however the byzantines were not able to defeat the persians within five years so the muslims when they returned to the prophet peace be upon him and asked him how come the byzantines weren't able to defeat the persians within five years he said well the verses say which means three to nine so why didn't you agree to anything under 10. so he pretty much doubled down on the prophecy instead of taking it back or switching it up or something like that of course eventually within that time limit within those nine years the byzantines did defeat the persians says that when the prophecy actually came to pass a lot of people simply accepted islam now i want you to keep something in mind the riskiest type of prophecy to make are the ones that are limited to a specific time because if you're unable to see that prophecy through or for that prophecy to come to pass within that time limit you risk losing everything there's nothing to gain from making a time limited prophecy however it was due to the prophet peace be upon him confidence in allah and in the quran that he was able to make this prophecy and of course naturally it came to pass that's all i have for you guys today sarah might have liked
